distress.text: A damaged survey vessel broadcasts a warning near a disputed boundary. Your crew awaits orders.

analysis.text: The supposed weapons discharge is a hazardous natural pulse. The vessels are reacting to bad sensor data.

choices.label: Transmit the corrected science to both ships

parley.text: Both captains agree to a brief ceasefire if you can establish neutral communication.

intervention.text: Your defensive interception saves the civilian crew, but a stray burst damages your ship.

peace.text: Evidence and diplomacy avert the fight. Both crews survive.

costly.text: The threat ends, but your ship needs repairs.

withdrawal.text: You survive, but the dispute remains unresolved.
